title: Jucy British Courgettes Pilaf
description: A light and flavorful pilaf dish from Britain, featuring katsuramuki-cut courgettes, perfect for springtime meals. This low-carb-friendly recipe is a crowd-pleaser that's sure to become a staple in your kitchen.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it begins to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the katsuramuki-cut courgettes to the skillet and cook for about 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Pour in the chicken broth and white wine, and stir to deglaze the skillet.
Add the flour to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the skillet to high heat and bring the liquid to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for about 10-12 minutes, until the courgettes are tender.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until it's fully melted and the pilaf is creamy.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
